lines.text: Elijah the Tishbite tells Ahab that there will be neither dew nor rain except at his word.
The LORD sends Elijah to hide by the Brook of Kidron, where ravens bring him bread and meat.
When the brook dries up, Elijah goes to Zarephath, where a widow says she has little flour and oil.
Elijah tells the widow to make him a small cake first, and her flour and oil last until rain.
After the widow's son dies, Elijah stretches over him five times, and the LORD restores his life.
